For each disjunctive witness the proof can select the full-ownership left disjunct. The only nontrivial pure obligation is the unsigned increment in entail_wit_2_1; it follows internally from the finite, disjoint DLL ownership bound and does not require a public UINT_MAX premise. proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the full-ownership left disjunct of each OR. Initialize by opening xizi_dll. For the general loop step, unfold the unprocessed segment; establish local in-proof segment-concat and ownership-count assertions by induction; use the ownership count to prove the 32-bit increment does not wrap; and normalize app/Zlength equations. Handle the first iteration as the nil-prefix specialization. At return, reduce any segment starting at its own stop to nil, reuse the local segment-induction pattern for the nonempty case, and close xizi_dll with the sentinel stores. Keep all auxiliary assertions inside the assigned witness proof bodies; no case_lib declaration is required.
